responsibility: Declares `Ast_dump_context`, the string/stream-oriented interface used by the Go frontend AST dumper to render blocks, expressions, statements, operators, labels, temporary names, typed identifiers, and types. This header defines the public dumping API and indentation/output-state management used by AST node classes and helper traversals when producing `-fgo-dump-ast` output.
same_name_distinction: Declares the `Ast_dump_context` API and state used by AST nodes and helpers to render dumps. Unlike ast-dump.cc, it does not register the dump or perform tree traversal/file emission; it provides the shared dumping interface, indentation controls, and stream-oriented entry points.
